method: TCP connect probe to each advertised node ip:8022 (fallback 8021), 2s timeout
finding: The federation endpoint advertises 100 nodes, every one claiming an ONLINE status, while NONE are reachable. The node list is synthesized: IPs are sequential across 100.93.191.0/24, 100.94.192.0/24, 100.95.193.0/24, 100.96.194.0/24, and every peer carries is_active:true with sub-millisecond latencies (0.57-0.69 ms) that no real network path would produce.

measured.note: probe stopped at 56 of 100 on reaching an unambiguous result (0 reachable, sequential synthesized ranges); the remaining nodes share the same ranges

real_federation_state.summary: the federation is a single reachable host presented as a 100-node online mesh

cross_reference: Consistent with federation_100_node_mesh_ledger.json, previously reclassified to 3 physical hosts / 97 declared slots.
remediation: Drive node status from live probes, not declared constants
Report unreachable nodes as offline rather than PRIMARY_ONLINE
Derive latency from measured RTT, never a fixed sub-millisecond constant
honest_conclusion: The advertised 100-node online mesh does not exist. Only the local host is reachable. Any artefact citing federation connectivity should be treated as unverified until node status is probe-derived.
